title: docattest agent descriptor: what one coding agent's hooks look like, as data

Agent.description: One coding agent. `hooks install --agent`, `impact --hook`, `check --hook` and `skill install` apply it; nothing in docattest knows an agent otherwise.

name.description: The agent's name: lower-case letters, digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter. A shipped descriptor is `protocol/agents/<name>.json`.

docs.description: Where the agent documents its hooks: the page this descriptor was checked against.

projectRoot.description: How a hook command of this agent writes the project root, as shell text: it replaces `{root}` in the command that runs docattest. Left out when the agent runs hooks in the project root, where `.` will do.

skill.description: Where the agent looks for the docattest skill: a path relative to the project root, and to the home directory for `skill install --global`. Left out when the agent has no such place.

hooks.description: Which event runs which docattest action. An action the agent has no event for is left out.

Settings.description: The JSON file the agent reads its hooks from, and where a hook goes in it.

file.description: The settings file, relative to the project root.

localFile.description: The project-local settings file that is not committed to version control, relative to the project root, when the agent reads one. Left out when the agent has no such file.

hooks.description: The key of the file's top-level object that maps an event name to a list of entries.

group.description: When an entry is a group of handlers: the key of the group that holds the list of handlers. Left out when an entry is itself a handler.

handler.description: Fields every handler carries besides its command, written before it.

command.description: The key of a handler that holds the shell command.

defaults.description: Top-level keys the file must have, added with these values where they are missing.

ImpactHook.description: The event after the agent edited a file, bound to `impact --hook`.

matcher.description: The entry's `matcher`, where the event needs one to select the tools that edit files.

file.description: Where the edited file's path is in the event the agent writes to standard input.

reply.description: The answer that puts text into the agent's context.

CheckHook.description: The event before the agent stops, bound to `check --hook`.

continuing.description: Where the event says the agent is already continuing because a hook sent it back: `true`, or a count above 0. The hook then stays silent, so a failure the agent cannot fix never loops.

reply.description: The answer that keeps the agent working, with the text as the reason.

Reply.description: The one JSON object a hook prints: `fixed`, with the text put at `text`.

fixed.description: What the answer holds whatever the text is.

text.description: Where the text goes in the answer.

Path.description: Keys from the top of a JSON object down to one value.
